name: mcp
description: The MCP endpoint over a listening server, with the official MCP client (@modelcontextprotocol/client): initialize, tools/list and tools/call through the HTTP runtime's gate and the engine's access policy, a refused call as a tool error carrying the problem document, an unknown tool as a JSON-RPC error, the 2026-07-28 revision beside the 2025 ones, the behavior catalog's tools, service callers, and the core's behaviors' operations as tools. The HTTP API and the MCP endpoint are mounted on one app. On Node.js the server is @hono/node-server, on Bun it is Bun.serve.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.title: List schemas
tools.description: Lists the schemas this namespace reaches, its own and the shared namespace's, with each one's live version and whether it has a draft.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which schemas this namespace reaches and which of them have a live version.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's fields or operations; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each schema's name, its live version and whether it has a draft.

tools.name: describe_schema
tools.title: Describe a schema
tools.description: Returns a schema's describe document: how a UI shows an instance (its display, and each field's title and icon), the JSON Schema of an instance, the behaviors its type composes with their config, and every operation with its parameters, its result and its tool.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use before calling a schema's tools: it gives the JSON Schema of an instance, each behavior with its config and summary, and each operation with its parameters, result and guidance.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read instances; call the schema's get or list.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the describe document of the live version.

tools.name: define_schema
tools.title: Define a schema draft
tools.description: Stores a schema-file document (the form superschematic format --to=json writes) as the draft of its name, replacing the draft before it. It does not publish: a draft goes live only through the HTTP publish route.

document.description: The schema-file document: kind General, a name, and the types; superschematic format --to=json writes it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to store a schema-file document as the draft of its name, replacing the draft before it.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to publish: a draft goes live only through the HTTP publish route.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the draft, with its name and hash; the live version is unchanged.

tools.name: list_behaviors
tools.title: List behaviors
tools.description: Lists the behaviors this engine runs, which a schema's types may compose: each one's name and description, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, and the fields and operations it adds.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use before composing behaviors in a draft, to learn which behaviors this engine runs.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of its behaviors; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each behavior's name, description, requirements, conflicts, fields and operations.

tools.name: describe_behavior
tools.title: Describe a behavior
tools.description: Returns a behavior's declaration: the JSON Schema of the config a type gives it, of the parameters a create gives it and of the entry a write's preconditions carry for it, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, its fields, its operations with their scope, parameters, result and invocation policy, and the codes its vetoes carry.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn what a behavior takes before composing it: its config, its create parameters, its preconditions and the codes its vetoes carry.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of the behavior; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the behavior's declaration, with its defaults filled in.

tools.name: get_value
tools.title: Get a stored value
tools.description: Returns a value the engine stores by its hash, { hash, bytes, value }: a field whose JSON is longer than the engine's threshold, which an event (and an instance read with valueRefs) carries as a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }. The caller must be able to read a schema of this namespace whose instances, events or behaviors hold the value.

hash.description: The value's hash: the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON, as a ref's $value holds it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read a large field an event, or an instance read with valueRefs, carries as a ref ({ "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }), by its hash.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read an instance; call its schema's get, which returns every field inline unless valueRefs asks for refs.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the value with its hash and its size in bytes.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.title: List namespaces
tools.description: Lists the namespaces the caller may see: each one's name, whether the engine's options configure it or a create made it, whether it is the shared namespace, and whether it is archived.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which namespaces you may see, and whether each is archived.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to list a namespace's schemas; call list_schemas.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each namespace's name, origin (configured by the engine's options, or created), whether it is the shared namespace, and its state (active or archived).

tools.name: create_namespace
tools.title: Create a namespace
tools.description: Creates a namespace, which holds schemas and instances of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself. Its name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to make a namespace for a new project: it starts with no schemas of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to make a schema; call define_schema in the namespace. Do not use for a name that is a namespace already, archived or not: the create is refused (conflict).
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, active, with who made it and when.

tools.name: archive_namespace
tools.title: Archive a namespace
tools.description: Archives a namespace a create made: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, and it refuses every write, and runs no reaction or schedule, until it is unarchived.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use when a project made with create_namespace is finished: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, every write is refused (namespace_archived), and its reactions and schedules stop.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on a namespace the engine's options configure, which is refused (conflict), or to remove data: nothing is removed.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, archived, with who archived it and when; archiving an archived namespace changes nothing.

tools.name: unarchive_namespace
tools.title: Unarchive a namespace
tools.description: Lets an archived namespace be written again; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to write again to an archived namespace.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on an active namespace, which stays as it is.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, active; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.

tools.name: item_create
tools.title: Create Item
tools.description: Creates a Item: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

id.description: The instance id; the engine makes one when it is absent

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Item: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

tools.name: item_get
tools.title: Get Item
tools.description: Returns the Item with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Item to read.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Item instances; call list.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

tools.name: item_list
tools.title: List Item
tools.description: Lists Item instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

cursor.description: The previous page's next

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Item instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

tools.name: item_update
tools.title: Update Item
tools.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Item with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Item

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Item with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq.

tools.name: item_delete
tools.title: Delete Item
tools.description: Deletes the Item with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Item with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

tools.name: item_increment
tools.title: Item: increment
tools.description: Adds to the count.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

tools.name: item_history
tools.title: Item: history
tools.description: Lists what each increment added.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

tools.name: item_flag
tools.title: Item: flag
tools.description: Operation flag of behavior test.Flag.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

tools.name: item_unflag
tools.title: Item: unflag
tools.description: Operation unflag of behavior test.Flag.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

tools.name: item_explode
tools.title: Item: explode
tools.description: Operation explode of behavior test.Broken.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to make a schema; call define_schema in the namespace. Do not use for a name that is a namespace already, archived or not: the create is refused (conflict).

s31.name: archive_namespace
s31.title: Archive a namespace

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use when a project made with create_namespace is finished: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, every write is refused (namespace_archived), and its reactions and schedules stop.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on a namespace the engine's options configure, which is refused (conflict), or to remove data: nothing is removed.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, archived, with who archived it and when; archiving an archived namespace changes nothing.

s49.name: review_mark_read
s49.title: Review: markRead
s49.description: Moves the caller's read marker past the messages it has read: on the conversation's top-level messages, or with thread on that thread's replies. upTo is the greatest message id the caller has shown; every posted or interrupted message of the listing with an id up to it is read, and a streamed reply that comes to stand later is not. The marker never moves back. Only the caller reads it back, so it appends no event, and a caller who may read the instance may call it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

thread.description: The id of a top-level message: the marker moved is the caller's on its thread's replies, whether the caller follows it or not. The conversation's when absent.

upTo.description: The greatest id of the messages read: a bound, which need not name a message.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to mark the conversation's top-level messages read, or with thread that thread's replies, up to the message id upTo the caller has shown; a streamed message that comes to stand later stays unread. The marker never moves back. It writes only the caller's read state, appends no event and needs only read.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns readUpTo, the marker, and unread, how many messages of others in the listing stand above it.

s50.description: Follows a thread, so each reply that comes to stand in it records a delivery for the caller and the inbox lists it, or with on false stops. A caller follows each thread it posts in and each it is mentioned in without asking, again after it stopped. Following counts the thread's replies from the latest message of the conversation. Only the caller reads it back, so it appends no event, and a caller who may read the instance may call it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

thread.description: The id of the thread's top-level message.

It writes only the caller's state, appends no event and needs only read.

Each page says where the next older and newer ones start.

A composing message's draft, a deleted message and the text before an edit are never found. s62.name: comments_claim_deliveries
s62.title: Comments: claimDeliveries
s62.description: Claims deliveries that are due, at most limit, oldest due first, under one new token that lapses after ttlMs, so two notifiers never send one twice: each pending one, each failed one whose next attempt has come, and each claimed one whose claim lapsed. Only deliveries of schemas the caller may read whose config names a deliverPermission the caller holds; with subjects or prefix, only theirs. A due delivery whose message no longer stands, or whose subject has read it, is dropped and not returned. Each delivery carries what a notifier needs to act with no other read.

s79.description: Posts a message as the caller: top-level, or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread. A ref block's instance must be one the caller may read, each block's kind one the config allows, and an attachment's uri scheme, media type and size ones the config's attachments allow. A caller acting for someone records that subject as the message's for. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted or began returns that message and posts nothing.

superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change the instance's fields; call update.

s80.name: documents_begin
s80.title: documents: begin
s80.description: Begins a message as the caller, composing: it takes its id and its place in the conversation now, top-level or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread, and shows the caller as writing. Its author adds the text with appendDraft and posts it with finish; one whose author appends nothing for the config's composeTimeoutMs is interrupted. Nothing is counted until it is finished or interrupted. A caller may have at most the config's maxDrafts composing messages on the instance. A caller acting for someone records that subject as the message's for; finish and interrupt keep it. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted or began returns that message and begins nothing.

Give clientId to make a retry safe, as for post. It is beside the instance: the instance's seq and ETag do not move, and a lease held by another does not stop it.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for a message written all at once; call post.

s81.name: documents_append_draft
s81.title: documents: appendDraft
s81.description: Appends text to the draft of the caller's composing message, and once the call commits sends the draft signal, { message, offset, text }, to the streams open on the instance. A reader that opens the conversation midway reads the draft so far as the message's body and follows the signals from its length. Its author only; the draft holds at most the config's maxBodyLength code points. An empty text appends nothing and sends nothing, and still counts as an append, so an author at work with nothing to show keeps its message from being interrupted. It appends no event.

An empty text adds nothing and keeps the message from being interrupted: send one at least every 1 minute while working with nothing to show. It appends no event.

s83.name: documents_interrupt
s83.title: documents: interrupt
s83.description: Stops a composing message: it becomes interrupted, its draft its body, or deleted when its draft holds no text. Its author may at any time, and so may a caller holding moderatePermission; any caller the policy lets write may once the author has appended nothing for the config's composeTimeoutMs, which is how the engine's runner interrupts a message whose author has stopped, on its schedule. An interrupted message is counted from now.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to stop a composing message, keeping the draft as its body, state interrupted, or deleting it when the draft has no text. Its author may at any time, and a caller with permission documents.moderate; anyone else once its author has appended nothing for 1 minute, as the engine's runner does.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to drop a draft; its author calls deleteMessage.

A ref block not on the message before must name an instance the caller may read, and an attachment not on it before must be one the config's attachments allow; a code block equal to the one at its place before keeps its moves. Acting for the author is not being it: only the author's own subject, or moderatePermission, may edit.

s96.name: documents_list_messages
s96.title: documents: listMessages
s96.description: Lists a page of the conversation's top-level messages, or with thread a page of that thread's replies, composing and deleted ones included, a composing one with its draft so far as its body, in ascending id order: the latest page when no anchor is given, the page before or after a message id, or the page around a message of the listing. Each page says where the next older and newer ones start.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

after.description: The page is the earliest messages with a higher id.

around.description: A message of the listing: the page holds it and the messages either side of it. At most one of around, before and after.

before.description: The page is the latest messages with a lower id.

limit.description: At most this many messages; 50 when absent.

thread.description: The id of a top-level message: the page is its thread's replies, and the result carries the message as root.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read the conversation a page at a time, in ascending id order: the top-level messages, or with thread a thread's replies and its top-level message as root. With no anchor it reads the latest page; before reads older, after newer, around a page about one message. A composing message is in its place, its body the draft so far.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not page through it for one message; call getMessage.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items, before and after; pass before as before for the older page and after as after for the newer, each null at its end.

errors.description: Comments: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the conversation with listMessages for the ids it has; a purged message is gone.

errors.description: Comments: thread names a reply, not a top-level message: post, begin, listMessages, resolve, reopen, markRead and follow. details: message, thread, the reply's thread.
errors.commonCorrection: Name the top-level message, the reply's thread, instead.

s97.name: documents_get_message
s97.title: documents: getMessage
s97.description: Reads one message of the conversation, a deleted one included; a composing one's body is its draft so far, from which a reader follows the draft signals.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read one message's record by its id, a deleted one's included; a composing message's body is its draft so far, which draft signals extend.

errors.description: Comments: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the conversation with listMessages for the ids it has; a purged message is gone.

s98.name: documents_list_edits
s98.title: documents: listEdits
s98.description: Lists what a message held before each of its edits, oldest first, one page at a time.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many edits; 50 when absent.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read what a message held before each of its edits, oldest first, with who made each edit and when.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.

s99.name: documents_list_reactions
s99.title: documents: listReactions
s99.description: Lists who reacted to a message with an emoji, in the order they reacted, one page at a time.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

emoji.description: The reaction: an emoji's name or the character itself, at most 32 code points.

limit.description: At most this many reactions; 50 when absent.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read who reacted to a message with one emoji, in the order they reacted.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.

s100.name: documents_list_pinned
s100.title: documents: listPinned
s100.description: Lists the conversation's pinned messages, top-level and replies, in ascending id order, one page at a time. Only a posted or interrupted message is pinned: a deleted one loses its pin, and a composing one cannot take one.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many messages; 50 when absent.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read the conversation's pinned messages, top-level and replies, in ascending id order.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items, each a record, and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.

s101.name: documents_list_revisions
s101.title: documents: listRevisions
s101.description: Lists the instance's revisions, oldest first, one page at a time.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many revisions; 50 when absent.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read the instance's revisions, oldest first: each its number and the own fields as that change left them.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not page through them for one revision; call getRevision with its number.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.

s102.name: documents_get_revision
s102.title: documents: getRevision
s102.description: Reads one of the instance's revisions by its number: the own fields as that change left them. A number the instance has not reached is not_found.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read one revision by its number, the one a pinned link or a proposal names say: the own fields as that change left them.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the revision; a number the instance has not reached is not_found.

s103.name: documents_propose
s103.title: documents: propose
s103.description: Proposes a change to the instance's own fields as a JSON merge patch, for a reviewer to approve or reject. The patch must change the instance and leave it valid; nothing changes until a reviewer approves it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

evidence.description: Instances the proposal cites, for the reviewer: each one must exist and the proposer must be able to read its schema, and a revision must be one it has had, of a schema that composes Revisions. They are kept as given; a later change of an instance cited leaves them as they are.

revision.description: The revision of it the proposal rests on.

schema.description: The schema of the instance cited.

patch.description: A JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) of the instance's own fields.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to propose a change of the own fields, as a JSON merge patch, for a caller with permission documents.review to approve. evidence cites instances the proposer may read, each optionally at a revision it has had.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change the instance at once; call update.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the pending proposal with its id and its evidence; the instance does not change until it is approved.

s104.name: documents_approve
s104.title: documents: approve
s104.description: Approves a pending proposal: applies its patch to the instance as an update, whose checks run, and records the revision it makes. Needs the review permission.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

proposal.description: The id of the pending proposal.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to apply a pending proposal; it needs permission documents.review, else the call is forbidden.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the proposal, approved, with the revision its patch made.

errors.description: Revisions: approve or reject of a proposal that is no longer pending.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the proposal with listProposals: someone has already settled it.

s105.name: documents_reject
s105.title: documents: reject
s105.description: Rejects a pending proposal; the instance does not change. Needs the review permission.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

proposal.description: The id of the pending proposal.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to turn a pending proposal down, with an optional reason; it needs permission documents.review, else the call is forbidden.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the proposal, rejected; the instance does not change.

errors.description: Revisions: approve or reject of a proposal that is no longer pending.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the proposal with listProposals: someone has already settled it.

s106.name: documents_list_proposals
s106.title: documents: listProposals
s106.description: Lists the instance's proposals, oldest first, one page at a time; with state, only those in it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many proposals; 50 when absent.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read the instance's proposals, oldest first, each with the evidence it cites; with state, only the pending, approved or rejected ones.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.

allOf.description: While kind is "review", result is a ReviewResult
While kind is "verify", result is a VerifyResult
While kind holds another value or none, result holds none

result.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

id.description: The instance id; the engine makes one when it is absent

s108.useWhen: Use to create a new Step: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one. Give kind at create: it does not change after it, and one left absent stays absent. Give result the shape kind picks: result holds ReviewResult when kind is review or VerifyResult when kind is verify, and nothing while kind holds another value or none.
s108.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
s108.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

cursor.description: The previous page's next

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

s110.useWhen: Use to page through Step instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title or kind; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's.
s110.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
s110.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

allOf.description: While kind is "review", result is a ReviewResult
While kind is "verify", result is a VerifyResult
While kind holds another value or none, result holds none

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Step

result.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

s112.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Step with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq. A patch of result keeps the shape kind picks, as merged; the describe document shows each shape under allOf.
s112.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not change kind: a change is refused as invalid_instance, with rule constant at the field.
s112.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq.

namespace.description: The namespace that holds the instance

schemaNamespace.description: The namespace that holds the schema

version.description: The schema version the instance was last written with

seq.description: The sequence of the instance's last event: its entity tag

result.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

allOf.description: While kind is "review", result is a ReviewResult
While kind is "verify", result is a VerifyResult
While kind holds another value or none, result holds none

behaviors.description: The instance's behaviors' fields, by behavior name, apart from its own fields

valueRefs.description: For a read with valueRefs: the JSON pointers into data of the fields that hold a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, in place of a value the value store holds

s114.name: tasks
s114.description: A task an engine runs with the core's behaviors and no extension: it moves from todo through doing to done, waits for its blockers, a task or a document, before it is done, and links to the document it implements, pinned to a revision, to a parent task and to its project, which every create gives.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.title: List schemas
tools.description: Lists the schemas this namespace reaches, its own and the shared namespace's, with each one's live version and whether it has a draft.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which schemas this namespace reaches and which of them have a live version.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's fields or operations; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each schema's name, its live version and whether it has a draft.

tools.name: describe_schema
tools.title: Describe a schema
tools.description: Returns a schema's describe document: how a UI shows an instance (its display, and each field's title and icon), the JSON Schema of an instance, the behaviors its type composes with their config, and every operation with its parameters, its result and its tool.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use before calling a schema's tools: it gives the JSON Schema of an instance, each behavior with its config and summary, and each operation with its parameters, result and guidance.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read instances; call the schema's get or list.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the describe document of the live version.

tools.name: define_schema
tools.title: Define a schema draft
tools.description: Stores a schema-file document (the form superschematic format --to=json writes) as the draft of its name, replacing the draft before it. It does not publish: a draft goes live only through the HTTP publish route.

document.description: The schema-file document: kind General, a name, and the types; superschematic format --to=json writes it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to store a schema-file document as the draft of its name, replacing the draft before it.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to publish: a draft goes live only through the HTTP publish route.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the draft, with its name and hash; the live version is unchanged.

tools.name: list_behaviors
tools.title: List behaviors
tools.description: Lists the behaviors this engine runs, which a schema's types may compose: each one's name and description, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, and the fields and operations it adds.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use before composing behaviors in a draft, to learn which behaviors this engine runs.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of its behaviors; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each behavior's name, description, requirements, conflicts, fields and operations.

tools.name: describe_behavior
tools.title: Describe a behavior
tools.description: Returns a behavior's declaration: the JSON Schema of the config a type gives it, of the parameters a create gives it and of the entry a write's preconditions carry for it, the behaviors it requires and conflicts with, its fields, its operations with their scope, parameters, result and invocation policy, and the codes its vetoes carry.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn what a behavior takes before composing it: its config, its create parameters, its preconditions and the codes its vetoes carry.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read a schema's config of the behavior; call describe_schema.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the behavior's declaration, with its defaults filled in.

tools.name: get_value
tools.title: Get a stored value
tools.description: Returns a value the engine stores by its hash, { hash, bytes, value }: a field whose JSON is longer than the engine's threshold, which an event (and an instance read with valueRefs) carries as a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }. The caller must be able to read a schema of this namespace whose instances, events or behaviors hold the value.

hash.description: The value's hash: the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON, as a ref's $value holds it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read a large field an event, or an instance read with valueRefs, carries as a ref ({ "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }), by its hash.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read an instance; call its schema's get, which returns every field inline unless valueRefs asks for refs.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the value with its hash and its size in bytes.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.title: List namespaces
tools.description: Lists the namespaces the caller may see: each one's name, whether the engine's options configure it or a create made it, whether it is the shared namespace, and whether it is archived.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to learn which namespaces you may see, and whether each is archived.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to list a namespace's schemas; call list_schemas.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns each namespace's name, origin (configured by the engine's options, or created), whether it is the shared namespace, and its state (active or archived).

tools.name: create_namespace
tools.title: Create a namespace
tools.description: Creates a namespace, which holds schemas and instances of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself. Its name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to make a namespace for a new project: it starts with no schemas of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to make a schema; call define_schema in the namespace. Do not use for a name that is a namespace already, archived or not: the create is refused (conflict).
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, active, with who made it and when.

tools.name: archive_namespace
tools.title: Archive a namespace
tools.description: Archives a namespace a create made: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, and it refuses every write, and runs no reaction or schedule, until it is unarchived.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use when a project made with create_namespace is finished: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, every write is refused (namespace_archived), and its reactions and schedules stop.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on a namespace the engine's options configure, which is refused (conflict), or to remove data: nothing is removed.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, archived, with who archived it and when; archiving an archived namespace changes nothing.

tools.name: unarchive_namespace
tools.title: Unarchive a namespace
tools.description: Lets an archived namespace be written again; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to write again to an archived namespace.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on an active namespace, which stays as it is.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the namespace, active; its reactions and schedules pick up where they stopped.

tools.name: documents_create
tools.title: Create documents
tools.description: Creates a documents: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

id.description: The instance id; the engine makes one when it is absent

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Document: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. A new instance's status is draft.

tools.name: documents_get
tools.title: Get documents
tools.description: Returns the documents with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Document to read.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Document instances; call list.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

tools.name: documents_list
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: Lists documents instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

cursor.description: The previous page's next

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

anyOf.description: The state the instance is in.

items.description: The state the instance is in.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Document instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title, body or Workflow.status; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's. where: { "Workflow.status": <state> } lists the instances in one of draft, review, published or archived, and a list of states the instances in any of them.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

tools.name: documents_update
tools.title: Update documents
tools.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the documents with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Document

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Document with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not use to move Workflow's status, which behaviors.Workflow holds; call transition.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq. A change of the own fields records the next revision.

tools.name: documents_delete
tools.title: Delete documents
tools.description: Deletes the documents with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Document with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

tools.name: documents_transition
tools.title: documents: transition
tools.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to move status from draft to review; from review to draft or published; from published to archived. The move review to published needs permission documents.publish; without it the call is forbidden.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use from archived: no transition leaves a terminal state. Do not use to stay where the instance is.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns from and to; status holds to from then on, and enteredAt the time of the move.

errors.description: Workflow: No transition leads from the instance's status to the state named; details.allowed lists the states it can move to.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status, then name a state details.allowed lists, or move through one of them first.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status: the instance is already there, so nothing needs to move.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
errors.commonCorrection: None: the work has ended. Create a new instance to start again.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance has no status to move from.
errors.commonCorrection: None: an instance without a status cannot move.

tools.name: documents_post
tools.title: documents: post
tools.description: Posts a message as the caller: top-level, or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread. A composing message has no thread to reply in and cannot be quoted. A ref block's instance must be one the caller may read, each block's kind one the config allows, and an attachment's uri scheme, media type and size ones the config's attachments allow. A caller acting for someone records that subject as the message's for. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted or began returns that message and posts nothing.

tools.name: documents_move_anchor
tools.title: documents: moveAnchor
tools.description: Moves a code block of a posted or interrupted message to the same code at another revision, where a caller that knows the repository found it, a git extension after a push say: the block takes revision and lines and keeps its snippet, and records the anchor it was first given with as original, how many times it moved, and who moved it last and when; each move's event holds the steps between. It is not an edit: the message's text, editedAt, edits and edit window are untouched. Its author may move it; another caller needs the config's anchorPermission or moderatePermission.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

block.description: The code block's index in the message's blocks, from 0.

lines.description: The first and the last line of the same code at that revision, counted from 1, both included; the first is at most the last.

revision.description: The revision the code is at now: a commit's id, as the repository names it.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to move a code block of a posted or interrupted message to the same code at another revision, once the caller has found where it went (after a push, say): the block takes revision and lines, keeps its snippet, and records its first anchor as original and its moves; its author or a caller with permission documents.moderate may move it. It is not an edit: the body, editedAt, edits and the edit window are untouched. It is beside the instance: the instance's seq and ETag do not move, and a lease held by another does not stop it.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change what a code block quotes; edit the message.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the record, the block moved.

errors.description: Comments: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the conversation with listMessages for the ids it has; a purged message is gone.

errors.commonCorrection: Wait for the message's finish or interrupt event: a composing message is still being written.

errors.description: Comments: An edit or delete of another's message, or a resolve or reopen of another's thread, by a caller without moderatePermission (resolvePermission for a thread); a moveAnchor of a code block on another's message by a caller without anchorPermission or moderatePermission; or appendDraft or finish of another's composing message, which nobody but its author writes. A caller acting for the author is not its author. details: message, author.
errors.commonCorrection: Only its author or a caller with permission documents.moderate moves an anchor.

errors.description: Comments: moveAnchor of a block index the message's blocks do not reach. details: message, block, blocks, how many the message has.
errors.commonCorrection: Name a block the message has, counted from 0.

errors.description: Comments: moveAnchor of a block that is not a code block. details: message, block, kind.
errors.commonCorrection: Name a code block; only a code block has an anchor.

errors.description: Comments: moveAnchor to the revision and lines the code block is at already. details: message, block, revision, lines.
errors.commonCorrection: None: the block is at that revision and those lines already.

tools.name: documents_mark_read
tools.title: documents: markRead
tools.description: Moves the caller's read marker past the messages it has read: on the conversation's top-level messages, or with thread on that thread's replies. upTo is the greatest message id the caller has shown; every posted or interrupted message of the listing with an id up to it is read, and a streamed reply that comes to stand later is not. The marker never moves back. Only the caller reads it back, so it appends no event, and a caller who may read the instance may call it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

thread.description: The id of a top-level message: the marker moved is the caller's on its thread's replies, whether the caller follows it or not. The conversation's when absent.

upTo.description: The greatest id of the messages read: a bound, which need not name a message.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to mark the conversation's top-level messages read, or with thread that thread's replies, up to the message id upTo the caller has shown; a streamed message that comes to stand later stays unread. The marker never moves back. It writes only the caller's read state, appends no event and needs only read.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns readUpTo, the marker, and unread, how many messages of others in the listing stand above it.

errors.description: Comments: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the conversation with listMessages for the ids it has; a purged message is gone.

errors.description: Comments: thread names a reply, not a top-level message: post, begin, listMessages, resolve, reopen, markRead and follow. details: message, thread, the reply's thread.
errors.commonCorrection: Name the top-level message, the reply's thread, instead.

tools.name: documents_follow
tools.title: documents: follow
tools.description: Follows a thread, so each reply that comes to stand in it records a delivery for the caller and the inbox lists it, or with on false stops. A caller follows each thread it posts in and each it is mentioned in without asking, again after it stopped. Following counts the thread's replies from the latest message of the conversation. Only the caller reads it back, so it appends no event, and a caller who may read the instance may call it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

on.description: true to follow, false to stop.

thread.description: The id of the thread's top-level message.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to follow a thread, named by its top-level message, so each reply in it records a delivery for the caller and the inbox lists it; on false stops until the caller next posts in it or is mentioned in it. It writes only the caller's state, appends no event and needs only read.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns thread and following, whether the caller follows it now.

errors.description: Comments: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the conversation with listMessages for the ids it has; a purged message is gone.

errors.description: Comments: thread names a reply, not a top-level message: post, begin, listMessages, resolve, reopen, markRead and follow. details: message, thread, the reply's thread.
errors.commonCorrection: Name the top-level message, the reply's thread, instead.

tools.name: documents_list_messages
tools.title: documents: listMessages
tools.description: Lists a page of the conversation's top-level messages, or with thread a page of that thread's replies, composing and deleted ones included, a composing one with its draft so far as its body, in ascending id order: the latest page when no anchor is given, the page before or after a message id, or the page around a message of the listing. Each page says where the next older and newer ones start.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

after.description: The page is the earliest messages with a higher id.

around.description: A message of the listing: the page holds it and the messages either side of it. At most one of around, before and after.

before.description: The page is the latest messages with a lower id.

limit.description: At most this many messages; 50 when absent.

thread.description: The id of a top-level message: the page is its thread's replies, and the result carries the message as root.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read the conversation a page at a time, in ascending id order: the top-level messages, or with thread a thread's replies and its top-level message as root. With no anchor it reads the latest page; before reads older, after newer, around a page about one message. A composing message is in its place, its body the draft so far.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not page through it for one message; call getMessage.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items, before and after; pass before as before for the older page and after as after for the newer, each null at its end.

errors.description: Comments: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the conversation with listMessages for the ids it has; a purged message is gone.

errors.description: Comments: thread names a reply, not a top-level message: post, begin, listMessages, resolve, reopen, markRead and follow. details: message, thread, the reply's thread.
errors.commonCorrection: Name the top-level message, the reply's thread, instead.

tools.name: documents_get_message
tools.title: documents: getMessage
tools.description: Reads one message of the conversation, a deleted one included; a composing one's body is its draft so far, from which a reader follows the draft signals.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read one message's record by its id, a deleted one's included; a composing message's body is its draft so far, which draft signals extend.

errors.description: Comments: The id a call names, as message, thread, quotes or around, is not a message of the conversation, or a purged one; or around names a message outside the listing. details: message.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the conversation with listMessages for the ids it has; a purged message is gone.

tools.name: documents_list_edits
tools.title: documents: listEdits
tools.description: Lists what a message held before each of its edits, oldest first, one page at a time.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many edits; 50 when absent.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read what a message held before each of its edits, oldest first, with who made each edit and when.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.

tools.name: documents_list_reactions
tools.title: documents: listReactions
